up: I need to retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728495. For each compound, provide the compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the compound preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles, if available). The document is identified by its chembl_id in the docs table. Please return the list of distinct compounds.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495';
